methodology.protocol: Control and Deribit options treatment use identical BTC/ETH rows and calendar folds. Three deterministic trade samples per UTC day are fingerprinted and become visible only at the next UTC midnight.
methodology.selection: Thresholds use past folds only; 2026-H1 remains the final holdout.

methodology.folds: Five fixed calendar half-years from 2024-H1 through 2026-H1
methodology.nested_policy: For each fold, the preceding 180 days are split chronologically into reliability training, probability calibration, and policy selection. Test labels never select the threshold.
